description: Connect the business's own PBX or call-centre software to its Twilio or Telnyx numbers over SIP. originationUri is where incoming calls go (sip:pbx.example.com); outbound calls authenticate with username + password (generated when left out and shown once, never kept by Hermoso) and/or allowedIps. numbers moves those numbers' calls onto the trunk. On Twilio it is an Elastic SIP trunk with a <domain>.pstn.twilio.com termination address; on Telnyx an FQDN, IP or credential connection (sip.telnyx.com). Without confirm:true nothing is created and the answer says what would be. The carrier bills the calls. Free. Needs Twilio or Telnyx connected (Connectors, or connect_connector).

outboundVoiceProfileId.description: Telnyx: the outbound voice profile (default: the account's first)
